newsitem.title: USA: Norland Medical chairman raises stake.
newsitem.headline: Norland Medical chairman raises stake.

text.p: Norland Medical Systems Inc. Chairman Reynald Bonmati said Monday he raised his stake in the company to 2,182,500 common shares, or 30.7 percent of the total outstanding, from 1,995,000 shares, or 28.1 percent.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Bonmati said he bought 187,500 shares on Jan. 1 by exercising vested options previously granted to him.

He said he also holds options to buy an additional 30,000 shares at a $15 a share exercise price, with 7,500 of the shares having become exercisable on Jan. 1, and the rest becoming exercisable in equal increments of 7,500 each on Jan. 1, 1998, Jan. 1, 1999 and Jan. 1, 2000.
